_description: Human annotation template for participant influence evaluation.
_instructions: This template must be filled in by a human annotator.
Do NOT populate with fabricated or system-generated rankings.
Rankings must reflect genuine human judgment about decision influence.
Multiple annotators should fill in separate copies for inter-rater agreement.

meeting_level_ranking._instructions: List participants from most to least influential in decisions overall.

decision_rankings._instructions: Repeat this block for each decision.

inter_rater_notes: <Optional: notes about agreement/disagreement with other annotators>
